components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font: 500 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Signal Red removal action used for wallets, categories, and transactions.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 26px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); font: 500 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A 44px Hairline capsule with the shared Cobalt focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 500 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 26px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 30%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 16px; outline: none; } .ds-input:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A Mist track whose Paper indicator is the first of the system's two lifts.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); height: 44px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-seg-indicator { position: absolute; inset-block: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc((100% - 8px) / 2); border-radius: 26px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06); transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-seg-item { position: relative; z-index: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font: 500 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-item[data-checked] { color: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seg-indicator { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 56px; padding: 0 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)) 80%, transparent); font: 500 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-half { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; justify-content: space-around; } .ds-tab, .ds-new { display: flex; min-width: 56px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 2px; padding: 0 4px 6px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab span, .ds-new span { font-size: 14px; } .ds-current { color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-new b { display: flex; width: 48px; height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-new:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-scrim { display: flex; min-height: 320px; align-items: end; justify-content: center; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)) 40%, transparent); } .ds-sheet { width: 100%; max-height: 85dvh; overflow: auto; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-sheet-header { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; } .ds-sheet-header div { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-sheet h2, .ds-sheet p { margin: 0; } .ds-sheet h2 { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-sheet p { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); font-size: 14px; } .ds-sheet button[aria-label] { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; } .ds-sheet > a, .ds-sheet > button:not([aria-label]) { display: flex; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: transparent; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-sheet button:hover, .ds-sheet a:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-sheet button:focus-visible, .ds-sheet a:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.52 0.2 262)) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Bookkeeping is a bank statement rendered as a phone-first web app: Paper behind near-black Inter, JetBrains Mono for every money figure, and one Cobalt action that is easy to reach after paying. It plays the clean modern fintech canon straight. Trust comes from exact money, quiet hierarchy, predictable controls, and motion used only to explain a state change.

Density is calm and columnar. Home answers the daily questions in one pass; deeper screens keep the same flat rows, hairlines, and narrow reading order. Controls are capsules, content is not boxed into cards, and the single display-size figure leads whenever a balance is the subject.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only Paper and achromatic greys with one Cobalt accent and Signal Red for validation or destruction.
Inter for language; JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals for THB and only THB.
Flat, hairline-divided rows; one display figure; capsules for controls.
A phone shell built around the title bar and bottom tab bar, with the desktop header taking over from 640px.
Lucide pictograms at stroke 1.75, paired with words except for universally understood, accessibly named controls.
Exactly three motion moments: segmented indicator, arriving row, and sheet.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Rule
rules.body: A screen has one Cobalt action. Selected states are separate: segment text, the chosen date or month, and a Select check may also be Cobalt. When the phone tab bar is present, its 48px ＋ is the action and page-level creates are outline buttons. When the tab bar is hidden, Save is the action. On desktop, New transaction in the header is the action. An empty state may use its own primary when it is the screen's sole next step.

rules.name: The Red Means Wrong Rule
rules.body: Signal Red means validation or destruction. Transaction type, direction, and sign use words and symbols rather than red or green alone.

rules.name: The Grey Steps Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is an achromatic OKLCH lightness step. Do not introduce tinted greys, warm whites, or a second accent.

rules.name: The Mono Is Money Rule
rules.body: The money treatment belongs only to THB figures and the amount input. Dates, counts, IDs, and labels remain Inter.

rules.name: The Always Satang Rule
rules.body: A figure is always ฿12,000.00: symbol, grouped whole baht, two decimals, and a true minus sign for negatives.

rules.name: The Step-Down Rule
rules.body: Only display-size figures step down the symbol and satang. Row and input figures remain uniform.

rules.name: The 44px Phone Control Rule
rules.body: Phone controls, including title-bar actions and filter chips, use a 44px target; the central ＋ and form Save are 48px. Desktop compact actions may reduce to 40px.

rules.name: The Two Lifts Rule
rules.body: Only the segmented indicator and floating popovers cast shadows. Sheets use their scrim; buttons, inputs, rows, tab bars, and content containers remain flat.

dos: Do render every THB figure with the money treatment and the full ฿12,000.00 form, right-aligned in lists.
Do keep one Cobalt action per screen, treating selected control states and the sole empty-state action as the documented exceptions.
Do use 44px phone controls, 48px for the central ＋ and form Save, and the same height for actions sharing a title bar.
Do build lists as full-bleed phone rows separated by Hairlines, inside the 672px column from 640px.
Do use the two lifts only for the segmented indicator and floating popovers; use a scrim for sheets.
Do keep motion to the indicator slide, arrival fade, and sheet slide, and remove all three for reduced motion.
Do pair pictograms with text; an icon-only control requires an accessible name and a universal glyph such as ‹, ✕, or a calendar arrow.
Do use the destructive variant for wallet, category, and transaction removal.
donts: Don't wrap list content in cards, tiles, or a card grid; the list is the surface.
Don't add a stat strip or more than one display-size figure to a screen.
Don't use a second Cobalt page action where the phone ＋, form Save, or desktop New transaction already owns the action.
Don't carry transaction type, sign, or direction by red or green alone.
Don't put shadows on buttons, inputs, rows, sheets, tab bars, or content containers.
Don't introduce tinted neutrals, a second accent, or a dark theme; the shipped product is light-only.
Don't set dates, counts, or labels in JetBrains Mono, or money in Inter.
Don't add grab handles to sheets or icon-only navigation labels.
Don't add motion beyond the three feedback moments or animate them under reduced motion.
